findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: each order triggers a separate SELECT for its line items, causing query count to grow with result set (reference 06-finding-n-plus-1).
findings.remediation: Replace per‑order line‑item SELECT with a single batch query (e.g., SELECT with WHERE order_id IN (…) or use SQLAlchemy selectinload to eager‑load items for all orders in one request).
findings.arithmetic: For a request listing 50 orders (each with 3 line items) the endpoint issues 1 query for orders + 50 queries for line items = 51 queries per request, which exceeds typical acceptable limits (e.g., <=5).
